proves.claim: export streams a board whose events exceed one string, and its digest is read the same way.

sync.large.export-streams-oversized-boar.why: Reading a huge event log as one string crashed export.

proves.claim: sync publishes a board whose events exceed one string.

sync.large.publish-oversized-board.why: Git sync must stream just as export does.

proves.claim: the events API honours its limit query and refuses a bad one.

sync.large.events-api-limit.why: An unbounded events read cannot be served for a large board.

proves.claim: a dead legacy Git lock is quarantined intact with recovery metadata outside it.

sync.git-lock.dead-lock-quarantined.why: Deleting a dead lock lost the evidence of who held it.

proves.claim: a live legacy Git lease has unknown expiry and an aborted waiter leaves it untouched.

sync.git-lock.live-lease-untouched.why: A waiter must never break a lease that may still be held.

proves.claim: an actual expired Git owner is fenced and its finally cannot release the successor.

sync.git-lock.expired-owner-fenced.why: A late release by an expired owner would free the new owner lock.

proves.claim: a callback error survives a real private SQLite cleanup failure.

sync.git-lock.callback-error-survives-cl.why: A cleanup failure must not hide the error that caused it.

proves.claim: a symlink owner file remains unknown and never supplies takeover authority.

sync.git-lock.symlink-owner-no-takeover.why: A symlink could point takeover at a file the owner does not control.

proves.claim: a socket closed before the first write fails the request, not the process.

sync.local.closed-socket-fails-request.why: undici raised an uncaught socket option error that killed the process.

proves.claim: local HTTP keeps response streams, request bodies, redirects and abort reasons.

sync.local.keeps-streams-and-redirects.why: The local fetch replacement must behave like fetch for these four cases.

proves.claim: no import specifier in the sync cell's source resolves to the landing barrel file.

sync.landing-door.no-barrel-import.why: Reaching landing through its barrel loads 94 modules the status path never needs.

proves.claim: requirePreparedComputedConflict from the light door is the barrel's own function.

sync.landing-door.same-function.why: The door must stay the same function, so moving the import changes no behaviour.

proves.claim: every sync-cell test registered here has a stable ID and one complete record, and an unregistered test is reported and fails only with tests.registryStrict on.

sync.registry.complete.why: Without a record per test a test can be deleted or duplicated with no one noticing what it proved.

proves.claim: with the caller passing the setting on, sync hands nameBehindDevice and the roster on.

sync.behind-device-pass.setting-on-hands.why: The options must reach the move preparation.

proves.claim: gitBoardOperation spreads the behind-device options into the prepareEngineMove options.

sync.behind-device-pass.source-spreads-o.why: A source check backs the real-move case.

proves.claim: with the setting off, no reader, or a failing reader, sync passes no behind-device option.

sync.behind-device-pass.setting-off-hand.why: A fault in the roster read must never block a move.

proves.claim: a real gitBoardOperation with the setting on passes the roster to prepareEngineMove, whose refusal names the device behind.

sync.behind-device-pass.real-move-names-.why: review found #9830 proven only by a source grep; the real move was never run.

proves.claim: a real gitBoardOperation with the setting off, no reader or a failing roster read leaves the refusal plain.
